nonblocking_findings: P2A1-1 [Major] overview rank tie-break: guide.ts:241 sorts the track-A rank by worst score then route name (a.route.localeCompare(b.route)), while spec D13 requires a tie to go to the higher worst blocker recall and then the higher median score. readTrackARank keeps per-pass date+score (median computable) and the score file holds the D13 counts, but guide.ts reads neither for the tie-break. No fixture or test pins a tie (review-scores-mini.json worsts are 84.0 vs 76.0; grep for tie/median/recall in guide.test.ts finds nothing). Rationale: an exact 1-decimal worst-score tie between routes could flip the pick or the second choice against the specified rank. Held nonblocking: the main-case order (worst score, complete-rank, 10-run rules) is correct and tested, and no complete track-A rank exists before Phase 4, so no current pick is affected.

P2A1-2 [Nit] closeout gate wording: test-strategy.md Phase 2 gate item 3 (git diff --name-only <phase_base_sha>..HEAD -- docs/ prints nothing) currently fails because unrelated daily-publish commit 05acc8c landed mid-phase. No Phase 2 commit touched docs/ (git log c22f313..6132fb7 -- docs/ lists only 05acc8c) and the working tree is clean, so D21 holds in substance. Rationale: the gate needs a carve-out for daily-publish commits or a re-captured base before the closeout read.

P2A1-3 [Nit] update.sh idempotency: after the approval, when the two data files are unchanged, git commit exits 1 under set -e, so a no-change weekly re-run fails and leaves the index staged. U2 always changes content, so the path is untested and the spec does not require idempotency. Rationale: minor operational wart only; the failure writes nothing to docs/ and commits nothing.
